race.title: 2027 Annual Badge At Tramore Racecourse Maiden Hurdle
race.verdict: A good opportunity for Triumph Hurdle sixth FORTY FIFTY to get off the mark on his return. Global Submission is the danger, with Flooring Brandy , a full brother to the classy Flooring Porter, well worth a look on debut. FORTY FIFTY (FR) GLOBAL SUBMISSION FLOORING BRANDY (IRE)
